question: Which article of the Indian Constitution comprises the fundamental duties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**51 - A**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 51-A** of the Indian Constitution enumerates the Fundamental Duties of Indian citizens.
 
• These duties were added by the **42nd Amendment Act** in **1976**, upon the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee.
 
• There are currently **11 Fundamental Duties** listed in Article 51-A.
